verdict.rationale: Postmark has a broad, well-structured API reference covering email, templates, bounces, messages, stats, servers, domains and webhooks, plus copyable TypeScript examples. A `POSTMARK_API_TEST` token and sandbox mode let developers run calls without actually sending email. Nothing shows an interactive, in-browser explorer with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console in the reference, runnable in-page examples, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent corroboration of the docs experience.
